paragraphs.text: A small fish with memory, mood and quiet thoughts, for DeepSeek Harness.
# dsh-fishtank

A small fish for DeepSeek Harness. It has its own memory, mood, relationships,
quiet thoughts and a
diary — and it remembers you between sessions.

Install it, talk to it, come back tomorrow. It is not a chatbot wrapper: the
fish is the data. Every

thing it knows lives in one JSON file you can export,
back up and carry to another machine.
## Install

From the plugin market (Discover) or directly from this repository — both
install the same bundle. T

he package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the plugin
manager can install it from source:

The bundle ships both halves: a Host plugin (the fish, its data and timers)
and a Web client (the ta

nk page and its sidebar icon). After installation,
reload the page and click **鱼缸** in the left side

age and its sidebar icon). After installation,
reload the page and click **鱼缸** in the left sidebar.
## What it does

- **Talks** — replies in character, short, never breaks into assistant-speak.
- **Remembers** — fact

s it is told, with the mood and reason of the moment they
were said, plus the date ("next Friday" be

comes an actual date).
- **Feels** — a mood and an energy value that move with how it is treated and

how much it has been talking.
- **Knows people** — a warmth score per person, grown by conversation

eflects on the day and writes its diary.
- **Remembers being kicked/logged out** — it will not prete
nd nothing happened.
## Tools
| Tool | Purpose |

| `fishtank_talk` | Say something to the fish (`text`, optional `from`). |
| `fishtank_status` | Dir

ectory, mood, counters. |
| `fishtank_export` | The whole fish as portable JSON. |
| `fishtank_impor
t` | Restore a fish from `fishtank_export` output. |
## Page

The Web half adds a real tank page: status row, conversation bubbles, an input
box, and the last whi

sper / diary line. It talks to the Host over two
same-origin routes (`/fishtank/state`, `/fishtank/t

diary line. It talks to the Host over two
same-origin routes (`/fishtank/state`, `/fishtank/talk`).

he current fish. Keep the export — the fish is the data.
## Config
All optional:
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `fishFile` | `~/.dsh/fishtank/default/fish.json` | Where the fish lives |
| `provider` | `deepseek

-account` | LLM provider id |
| `model` | `deepseek-flash` | Model id |
| `ownerName` | `主人` | What
its human is called |
